children: U.S. President Donald Trump continued posting attacks on Canada and other countries on Labor Day. According to Sina Finance, he also shared a hockey illustration on Sunday showing Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the ice while Trump, wearing a U.S. hockey jersey, said: "Get up, governor." Trump again referred to the Canadian prime minister as a "governor," after previously calling Justin Trudeau "Governor Trudeau."

title: Trump Again Calls Canadian Prime Minister a "Governor"
